founder.name: Ebrahim
founder.p1: What started as a passion project sharing stunning yacht photography has grown into one of Dubai's most recognized yacht media brands.
founder.p2: With over 900,000 followers on Instagram, Bimo Yacht has become the go-to destination for yacht enthusiasts, UHNW individuals, and serious buyers looking for their next vessel.
